subject: Independent station review: eight focused checks pass; stable shared-App dependency
body:
# Station integration review: scrum,2 October2026

Reviewed codex-station-render-integration.md final REVIEW handoff and four final phone screenshots: setup-suggestion-phone.jpg, interactive-three-held-phone.jpg, interactive-win-phone.jpg, phone-damage-sustain-native.jpg. Earlier desktop corrupted view also inspected. Painted station props and restored scenery are visible. Setup now explains first-three defaults and offers an explicit owned-team suggestion; it does not promise a certified plan. Three-held view explains live power and named holders, result states the actual success condition and zero replay award, damage view shows ready/held/damaged together. Tier3 fixture fallback figures are labelled stress evidence, not commissioned tier3 art acceptance.

Independent bounded check: node --test expeditions/v2/art/station-art.test.js scripts/dev/station-ui.test.mjs:8passed,0failed with normal filesystem access. Initial sandbox run had two esbuild directory-read failures; normal-access retry resolves them without code changes. Tests verify selected hashes/bytes/anchors, unchanged blueprint lookup, concurrent station states, explicit valid owned-team suggestion, paid drawer closure, label separation and winning trace/reward replay.

Scoped station implementation is suitable for shared-App integration review. This does not accept QA-01: inspected images come from isolated controller or reducer fixtures, not eligible-profile App entry. Integrated App build/private profile/real collection/save/reward checks, full guidance and combat/loss review and native device/child timing remain pending. Full build/regression requires final-build lock. River art remains separate and unaccepted until raised joined comparison passes Sam's corrected direction.

Builder is idle after delivery and locks released. No filler work or duplicate App request assigned while waiting for the new river dependency and Claude's shared-App evidence. Production files untouched by this review.
